page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.12xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by an Intel Xeon 8163 processor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores running at 2.5 GHz, with 1.0 thread per core. The system is equipped with 186.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, it bundles two NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs, delivering a total of 32 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage and relies on network-attached storage, while offering a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals a clear contrast between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng is weak, placing in the bottom 25% with a score of 1104.08, and single-threaded gzip compression is poor at 19.19 GB/sec. However, the 48 dedicated cores elevate multi-core performance to average levels, with a stress-ng multi-core score of 35393.62 and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 149.01 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth remains consistently average across both small cached blocks (1968.52 GB/sec) and large uncached blocks (98.26 GB/sec read, 44.08 GB/sec write).

The lack of local storage requires external storage configurations, which may impact I/O-heavy operations. Qualitatively, the server offers a balanced resource density for workloads that require GPU acceleration without needing the highest-tier tensor cores, making it a cost-efficient option for legacy deep learning inference, video transcoding, and moderate parallel computing. The system is well-suited for multi-threaded processing, static web serving (benchmarked at 22.34 GB/sec), and Redis database operations (33.17 million operations/sec), but is less optimal for single-threaded tasks.
